Smith native installer — Ubuntu 24.04 LTS x86_64, unprivileged user

Usage: smith-installer [--bundle ROOT] [--dry-run] [--model EXACT]
[--download-model] [--verify-inference]
smith-installer --artifacts-only [--client BUNDLE] [--service BINARY]
[--dry-run] [--yes]

--bundle ROOT       Recipient package root (default: actual executable directory)
--dry-run           Read-only artifact plan; no locks/writes, manager or provider
--model EXACT       Exact eligible local name:tag; no default model
--download-model    Offer separate curated GGUF download consent only if missing
--models            List the pinned local model catalog (no discovery/download)
--pull-model        Compatibility alias for --download-model
--verify-inference  Offer separate fixed minimal inference, not a saved chat turn
--artifacts-only    Developer artifact publication only; never register/start
--client BUNDLE     Complete paired Flutter bundle, only with --artifacts-only
--service BINARY    Native service artifact, only with --artifacts-only
--yes              Artifact plan consent only; requires --artifacts-only
-h, --help          Show help without operational discovery
-V, --version       Show version without operational discovery

Recipient confirmations are separate for artifacts, registration/reload, Start,
exact-model download, saved preference and optional inference. No recipient --yes.
CPU/Vulkan llama.cpp runtimes are bundled with CPU fallback; no Ollama, Python or Docker.
No OS/GPU provisioning, upgrades, lingering changes or GUI launch.
Use a prepared Ubuntu session and existing safe XDG roots.
Later decline/failure preserves prior effects; no automatic retry or rollback.

Smith graphical installer — prepared Ubuntu 24.04 LTS x86_64

Usage: smith-installer-ui [--bundle ROOT]
smith-installer-ui --help | --version | --licenses

--bundle ROOT  Complete recipient package (default: actual executable directory)
-h, --help     Print this finite document; no display or operational discovery
-V, --version  Print version; no display or operational discovery
--licenses Print bundled appearance notices; no display or discovery

Requires compatible GTK3 libraries and a graphical session for installation.
Includes the Smith app, menu/icon, user command and standalone service binary.
Install approves only the exact displayed artifact review. Register Smith service
and Start now are requested by default, with separate inline confirmations.
Model choice/download and a separately confirmed service-backed check follow.
Manage models bypasses artifact publication; exact-model removal is service-mediated.
CPU/Vulkan model runtimes and CPU fallback are bundled; no Ollama dependency. No OS/GPU provisioning, implicit upgrades or lingering changes.
No automatic app launch or rollback; stopping preserves accepted/uncertain effects.
The headless smith-installer CLI is separate and unchanged.
